title: desmazeria rigescens
intro: Desmazeria rigescens, commonly known as "Rigid Oat-grass," is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Desmazeria rigescens include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as asthma and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
